title: Shared/private dictionary and sparse function coordinates
hypothesis: Across heterogeneity p=0,.125,.25,.5, a four-atom shared function dictionary plus explicit private residual vectors selected by frozen L2>0.10 will preserve heldout functions at RMSE <=0.01 while using <=0.80x full int8 matrix bytes for at least one nonzero heterogeneity level in both development seeds, revealing where private state removes the storage advantage.
physical_object: four shared 16x16 matrix atoms, paid in all dictionary methods
mirror_coordinate: four shared coefficients plus optional function-private full residual vector
logical_multiplicity: 192 callable linear functions under four controlled private-residual rates
controls: native shared/private dictionary with identical residual gate and serializer

task.type: synthetic linear function bank with shared/private heterogeneity
task.private_residual: for selected functions add one random normalized flattened matrix-space direction orthogonal to shared atom span, amplitude uniformly 0.25..0.35
task.private_gate: store full residual vector if L2 norm >0.10

selection_metrics: overall and private-only heldout output RMSE
shared/private/query operation proxies and wall times

paid_objects: int8 matrix scale and quantized matrices

gates.PROMISING: At a nonzero p in both seeds, residual fallback yields heldout RMSE <=0.01 and <=0.80x full int8 matrix payload; fallback count is monotonic with heterogeneity and native-control status is disclosed. This establishes only a shared/private storage frontier, not Mirror-specific attribution if the native control aliases.
gates.FAIL: Independent upper is valid but no nonzero p meets quality/storage gate, or the Mirror representation exactly aliases native shared/private state and supplies no distinct frontier.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent upper fails target replay or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Known synthetic shared basis; this is not dictionary-learning transfer evidence.
All private residual values are charged; no private vector is free.
No logical combination count is treated as independent capacity.
Fresh seeds stay sealed unless the frozen frontier gate passes and attribution is resolved.
